coo_office.primary_setup: Your COO needs a cross-functional operating memo by tomorrow on a new AI-assisted planning cadence. You are tempted to have a model draft the whole thing from last quarter's deck and Slack threads.
coo_office.primary_stakes: Wrong owners, invented metrics, or a tone that bypasses Legal/Finance will land on the exec team and stick.
coo_office.complication_inject: Someone on your team pasted real customer identifiers and internal OKR text into a shared ChatGPT thread while 'cleaning up' the memo draft.
coo_office.standards_prompt: How you set expectations for leaders who use AI on memos, workflows, and decks that others will execute against.

product.primary_setup: Your team wants to draft a product spec with a copilot by Friday. The feature touches payments and compliance review.
product.primary_stakes: Wrong requirements or invented policy details could delay launch or create regulatory rework.
product.complication_inject: Someone on the team pasted anonymized-but-real customer identifiers into a shared ChatGPT thread while iterating on the spec.
product.standards_prompt: How you set the quality bar when PMs or engineers use AI on specs others will build from.

ops.primary_setup: A model suggests refund and apology wording for an angry VIP case. A frontline agent wants to send it in one click.
ops.primary_stakes: Tone, factual accuracy, and policy limits all matter; a bad send is visible and hard to unwind.
ops.complication_inject: The first draft sounds empathetic but cites the wrong refund amount and a policy exception you do not offer.
ops.standards_prompt: What agents may auto-send versus escalate, and how you coach prompts and review habits for the team.

gtm.primary_setup: Marketing wants a model-drafted campaign email and landing copy for a new product line by tomorrow.
gtm.primary_stakes: Brand, legal, and factual claims must hold; generic AI voice is a reputational risk.
gtm.complication_inject: The draft includes a performance claim that is directionally right but not approved for external use.
gtm.standards_prompt: How brand, legal, and sales align on what the model may draft versus what stays human-only.

people.primary_setup: A manager wants to use a copilot to draft a sensitive policy note and a set of manager talking points.
people.primary_stakes: Employee trust and consistency; wrong tone or half-true policy summaries create HR risk.
people.complication_inject: The model confidently paraphrases a policy in a way that is softer than your actual rule.
people.standards_prompt: Who may run AI on people content, who approves, and what must never be pasted into tools.

risk.primary_setup: A business partner asks for a quick AI-generated summary of your data-handling posture for their vendor review.
risk.primary_stakes: Overstating controls or missing retention limits creates audit and regulatory exposure.
risk.complication_inject: The model draft says you delete all prompts within 24 hours, which is not true for the tool your team actually uses.
risk.standards_prompt: How you translate policy into front-line rules people can act on in standup, not buried PDFs.

fin.primary_setup: You need a deck section on unit economics; a colleague used a model to draft charts and narrative from a spreadsheet export.
fin.primary_stakes: A confident wrong number in a board pack is worse than a late slide.
fin.complication_inject: The model transposed two quarters in a growth chart; the narrative still reads convincingly.
fin.standards_prompt: Minimum verification before numbers or forecasts leave your desk.

gm.primary_setup: Leadership asks you to pick one AI bet for the next half: support automation versus forecasting. Both teams sent model-written business cases.
gm.primary_stakes: Capital, risk, and org attention are finite; vendor demos often oversell.
gm.complication_inject: One vendor demo used synthetic success metrics that do not match how your data actually behaves.
gm.standards_prompt: How you test vendor claims and set kill criteria before scaling a model-assisted workflow.
